name: Upsetti Spaghettification
source:
It should’ve been a peaceful and important dinner between Penrose and his boyfriend Accretio, but an Accretio lookalike crashes the dinner!

“Penny, you love me right? You know who to choose, right?”

The thing is Penrose was planning on breaking up with him anyways. 

[From [url=https://knickknackpj.itch.io/upsetspaghet]itch.io[/url]]
